# Hypertask Documentation — Full Content

> This file contains the complete documentation for Hypertask, an AI-native project management tool. For a summary, see llms.txt.

## How AI Agents Should Use Hypertask

### Via MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Connect to `https://mcp.hypertask.ai` with a Bearer token. Available tools:
- `list_tasks` — List tasks with filters (project, section, assignee, priority)
- `get_task` — Get full task details by ticket number
- `create_task` — Create a new task with title, description (HTML), priority, assignee
- `update_task` — Update task fields (title, description, priority, due date, labels)
- `move_task` — Move a task between sections (e.g., Todo → Doing → Done)
- `assign_task` — Assign a user to a task
- `add_comment` — Add an HTML comment to a task
- `get_comments` — Get all comments on a task
- `search_tasks` — Full-text search across all tasks
- `list_projects` — List all projects/boards
- `get_sections` — Get sections for a project
- `inbox_list` — Check your notification inbox
- `inbox_archive` — Archive inbox notifications
- `get_user_context` — Get current user info and permissions

### Via CLI
Install: `npm install -g hypertask_cli`
Login: `hypertask login`

Key commands:
- `hypertask task list --project <id>` — List tasks
- `hypertask task get <ticket>` — Get task details (e.g., `hypertask task get HTPR-1234`)
- `hypertask task create --project <id> --title "..." --description "..."` — Create task
- `hypertask task update <ticket> --status "Doing"` — Update task status
- `hypertask task move <ticket> --section "Done"` — Move to section
- `hypertask task assign <ticket> --user <id>` — Assign user
- `hypertask comment add <ticket> --text "..."` — Add comment
- `hypertask comment list <ticket>` — List comments
- `hypertask search "query" --project <id>` — Search tasks
- `hypertask inbox list` — Check notifications
- `hypertask project list` — List all projects

### Task Description Format
Task descriptions and comments use **HTML**, not Markdown. Example:
```html
<p>Implement the new login flow with:</p>
<ul>
  <li>Email/password authentication</li>
  <li>OAuth support for Google and GitHub</li>
  <li>Rate limiting on failed attempts</li>
</ul>
```

### Agent Workflow Pattern
1. Check inbox for assigned tasks: `inbox list`
2. Pick up a task: `update_task` status to "Doing"
3. Read task details and comments for context
4. Do the work
5. Post progress updates as comments
6. Move task to "Review" when done
7. Archive inbox notification

### MCP Client Configuration

**Claude Desktop / Claude Code:**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hypertask": {
      "type": "streamablehttp",
      "url": "https://mcp.hypertask.ai/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Cursor:**
Add MCP server in Settings → MCP Servers with the same URL and auth header.

### Key Concepts
- **Projects** = boards/containers for related work
- **Sections** = columns (Todo, Doing, Review, Done)
- **Tasks** = work items with ticket numbers (e.g., HTPR-1234)
- **Comments** = threaded discussions on tasks (HTML format)
- **Labels** = tags for categorizing tasks
- **Priority** = Urgent, High, Medium, Low
- **Inbox** = notifications for assignments, mentions, updates
